info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Amazon API Gateway 2014 11 13 DEX Synthetic Application Monitoring API
APIs.io Engineering Platform List Cloudflare colos

params.name: account_id
params.description: unique identifier linked to an account in the API request path.

params.name: from
params.description: Start time for connection period in RFC3339 (ISO 8601) format.

params.name: to
params.description: End time for connection period in RFC3339 (ISO 8601) format.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Type of usage that colos should be sorted by. If unspecified, returns all Cloudflare colos sorted alphabetically.

items.docs: List Cloudflare colos that account's devices were connected to during a time period, sorted by usage starting from the most used colo. Colos without traffic are also returned and sorted alphabetically.
